title: Astra · controls study v2 pair 1 · shortcuts · 1–128

action.intent: Inspect population, food, drink, and fortress status before planning sustainable production.
Return to the map and open tree-felling designations to establish a wood supply.
Designate nearby trees for cutting and let the woodcutters begin gathering lumber.
Open carpenter workshop placement to establish furniture production.
Place the carpenter's workshop at the valid highlighted site and inspect material selection.
Select a bayberry log and allow construction of the carpenter's workshop.
Leave the build menu and run the fortress so the carpenter's workshop can be constructed.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop and verify it is ready for production.
Queue five beds at the completed, selected carpenter's workshop.
Queue two more beds so all seven starting dwarves can have a bed.
Queue two barrels for brewing and storage, then allow the carpenter time to work.
Leave workshop query and resume simulation so queued beds and barrels can be produced.
Open still placement to establish renewable drink production.
Place the still beside the carpenter and inspect available construction materials.
Select a log to build the still and allow construction to proceed.
Query the newly built still and verify it is ready for brewing.
Queue five brewing jobs at the completed, selected still to replenish drink supplies.
Leave workshop query and let dwarves work on the queued furniture and brewing jobs.
Inspect the still after the brewing cancellation to check its remaining jobs.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect its remaining jobs.
Prioritize an existing barrel job to unblock brewing, then allow carpentry to progress.
Leave workshop query so dwarves can finish the queued beds and barrels.
Inspect the carpenter's queue to verify progress on beds and brewing barrels.
Place the first finished bed near the workshops.
Designate a downward stair to create underground shelter; beds require an indoor location.
Designate the connecting underground staircase and excavate a room for beds and farming.
Place the first bed in the excavated underground shelter.
Place the first underground bed and let construction and excavation proceed.
Inspect the installed bed to establish shared sleeping quarters.
Define the installed bed's room for shared sleeping quarters.
Confirm the bedroom extent and enable shared dormitory use.
Place another bed in the confirmed communal dormitory.
Select the second bed and let dwarves finish construction and excavation.
Open farm-plot placement to establish an underground food supply.
Position a 3×3 farm plot on the excavated floor and check placement suitability.
Place the valid 3×3 underground farm plot and allow construction.
Inspect the new farm plot and its crop settings.
Select plump helmets and assign them to all seasons on the completed farm plot.
Select the surface carpenter's workshop and inspect its production queue.
Queue five beds at the selected carpenter's workshop to expand sleeping capacity.
Select the completed still to inspect its brewing queue.
Queue brewing at the selected completed still.
Exit workshop query and resume simulation so dwarves can brew drinks and finish beds.
Inspect the carpenter's queue after two thousand ticks of work.
Queue three barrels at the selected carpenter's workshop to support brewing and food storage.
Queue two tables for the future dining area while preserving one free workshop queue slot.
Queue a chair in the carpenter's last available job slot for the dining area.
Resume the fortress so dwarves can complete furniture and barrel jobs.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs and furniture production.
Inspect the still's brewing queue.
Inspect the underground farm and verify its crop assignment.
Keep plump helmets planted year-round and designate an underground food stockpile.
Reserve three barrels for production, then let dwarves haul food, farm, and finish workshop jobs.
Check population and food/drink stocks before continuing production.
Return to the fortress map to inspect workshop progress and farming.
Let dwarves finish queued furniture, barrels, brewing, and farm work.
Go upstairs and inspect workshop selection and production progress.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect remaining jobs.
Repeat the selected brewing job to sustain alcohol production, then allow dwarves to work.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop and its remaining furniture jobs.
Move the query cursor onto the carpenter's workshop and inspect its remaining jobs.
Queue three more dining chairs at the selected carpenter's workshop and allow production to proceed.
Resume simulation so dwarves can complete furniture, brewing, and farming jobs.
Inspect the underground farm and its planting settings.
Inspect the underground farm's crop settings.
Move the query cursor onto the farm to inspect its crop settings.
Place a third bed beside the existing dormitory beds.
Confirm the third bed, then select a dining table beside the sleeping area.
Select the carpenter’s workshop to produce missing dining furniture.
Queue three tables at the selected carpenter's workshop for a communal dining area.
Resume simulation so queued furniture and brewing jobs can progress.
Check food, drink, and population before continuing fortress development.
Drinks have increased to about 80; begin placing a dining table.
Place the first dining table underground near the dormitory and food stockpile.
Place the selected table, then select a chair beside it for dining.
Leave chair placement and let the carpenter finish queued furniture.
Place a chair beside the completed dining table.
Select the willow chair for construction beside the table and allow workers to build it.
Select the dining table and inspect room designation.
Define a compact dining room around the table and adjacent chair.
Enable the communal meeting hall and place another dormitory bed.
Confirm the fourth bed and resume the fortress so construction, farming, and brewing can progress.
Check food and drink reserves after the brewing cancellation before expanding the fortress.
Inspect the farm configuration and planting progress now that brewing has exhausted available plants.
Inspect the farm plot and its current planting configuration.
Inspect citizens to assign a farmer and establish reliable crop production.
Inspect the idle jeweler's labor settings to enable planting.
Return from Lokum's profile to locate the labor controls.
Locate Lokum on the map and open native labor preferences to assign farming.
Open Lokum's farming labor category to enable planting.
Select Farming/Related in Lokum's labor menu using native list navigation.
Enable Farming (Fields) for Lokum so the plump helmet plot can be planted.
Leave labor settings and allow Lokum to plant the configured farm.
Inspect active jobs to see whether farming has started and identify stalled production.
Return to the fortress and inspect the farm to diagnose why no planting jobs exist.
Inspect the farm plot's crop selection and planting status.
Confirm plump helmets for all seasons and allow planting to begin.
Inspect the farm's crop assignment because planting has not visibly started.
Confirm plump helmets for all seasons and allow farming to proceed.
Place another bed to expand sleeping capacity.
Place the fifth dormitory bed at the valid tile (25,9).
Select a bed for the fifth sleeping spot.
Place two more beds in the shared sleeping area and allow construction and farming to proceed.
Inspect the farm's crop assignment to establish reliable food and brewing supplies.
Set plump helmets for every season and allow farming and construction to progress.
Inspect the farm's crop assignment and planting status.
Confirm plump helmets for spring and all seasons, then allow planting work.
Inspect the farm's crop assignment and planting status.
Set plump helmets for every season and allow farmers time to plant.
Inspect the farm's crop settings and planting status.
Select the carpenter's workshop to prepare more dining chairs.
Queue three chairs at the selected completed carpenter's workshop for additional dining seats.
Resume simulation so the carpenter can finish three chairs and the farm can grow.
Open table placement underground to expand the dining area.
Place another dining table beside the existing dining area.
Place the dining table and prepare an adjacent chair.
Place the second dining chair and let construction and farming proceed.
Let the crops grow and dwarves continue hauling and maintaining the fortress.
Allow crops to grow while the stocked fortress continues operating.
Allow crops to grow and the fortress to continue operating.
Allow crops to mature and dwarves to harvest while advancing the fortress toward summer.
Allow planted crops to grow and the fortress to continue operating.
Allow crops to mature and dwarves to continue farming and hauling.
Resume fortress activity to allow crops to grow and advance toward the next supplies check.
Allow crops to grow and the fortress to continue toward summer.
Check food, drink, and harvest stocks before restarting brewing.
Return to the fortress and locate the still to brew the newly harvested plants.
Select the surface still to restart brewing.
